whatsappBot.welcome:
👋 Hi! I can connect you to your ISP account here on WhatsApp.

To verify it's you, reply with your *account email* and I'll send you a code — or open your customer portal (Profile → Connect WhatsApp) to get a linking code.
whatsappBot.emailSent: If that email is on file, I've sent a 6-digit code to it. Reply here with the code to finish connecting.
whatsappBot.bindOk: ✅ You're connected{{name}}! Your account features will be available here soon.
whatsappBot.menu:
Hi{{name}}! What can I help you with? Reply with a number:
1️⃣ Account balance
2️⃣ My plan & service
3️⃣ My invoices
4️⃣ Report a problem
5️⃣ Reset Wi-Fi password
6️⃣ Schedule a technician visit
7️⃣ Talk to a human
whatsappBot.askProblem: Please describe the problem in one message and I'll open a ticket for you. (Reply MENU to go back.)
whatsappBot.pickService:
Which service is this about? Reply with the number:
{{list}}
whatsappBot.pickInvalid: Please reply with the number of the service (e.g. 1), or MENU to go back.
whatsappBot.problemLogged: ✅ Thanks — I've opened ticket #{{id}} and our team will follow up. Reply MENU anytime.
whatsappBot.humanLogged: 👍 A team member will reach out. Your reference is ticket #{{id}}.
whatsappBot.ticketCapped: You already have open requests with us — our team is on it. Reply MENU for other options.
whatsappBot.aiEscalated: Thanks — I've passed this to our support team and someone will follow up here shortly. Reply MENU anytime.
whatsappBot.aiMenuHint: Reply MENU for the options list, or 7 to talk to a person.
whatsappBot.wifiConfirm:
🔐 I'll set a *new* Wi-Fi password and email it to {{email}} — I never show it here in chat. Your devices will need to reconnect with the new password.

Reply *CONFIRM* to proceed, or MENU to cancel.
whatsappBot.wifiNoEmail: To reset your Wi-Fi password securely I need an email on file to send the new one to. Please add one in your customer portal, or reply 7 to talk to a human.
whatsappBot.wifiApplied: ✅ Your new Wi-Fi password has been emailed to {{email}} and sent to your router. It takes effect when the router applies it, usually within a few minutes; then reconnect your devices with it.
whatsappBot.wifiFiled: ✅ Request submitted (#{{id}}). Our team will set a new Wi-Fi password and contact you shortly.
whatsappBot.wifiEmailFailed: I couldn't email your new Wi-Fi password just now, so I did NOT change it (to avoid locking you out). Please try again in a bit, or reply 7 to talk to a human.
whatsappBot.confirmInvalid: Reply *CONFIRM* to proceed, or MENU to cancel.
whatsappBot.askVisitDate: What day would you like a technician to visit? Reply with a date (e.g. 2026-08-05). Reply MENU to cancel.
whatsappBot.visitDateInvalid: Please reply with a date like 2026-08-05, or MENU to cancel.
whatsappBot.askVisitSlot:
What time works best? Reply:
1) Morning (8am–12pm)
2) Afternoon (12pm–5pm)
3) Evening (5pm–8pm)
whatsappBot.visitLogged: ✅ Visit requested for {{date}} ({{slot}}) — reference #{{id}}. We'll confirm the appointment. Reply MENU anytime.
whatsappBot.noService: You don't have an active service on file, so there's nothing to change. Reply 7 to talk to a human.
whatsappBot.actionCapped: You've made several requests recently — please wait a bit before trying again, or reply 7 to talk to a human.
whatsappBot.unlinked: Your WhatsApp number has been disconnected from your account. Reply with your email anytime to reconnect.
whatsappBot.codeBad: That code isn't valid or has expired. Reply with your email for a new one, or get a fresh code from your portal.
whatsappBot.codeMismatch: That code doesn't match. Check it and try again, or reply with your email for a new one.
whatsappBot.locked: Too many incorrect attempts. Please wait a bit, then request a new code.
whatsappBot.cooldown: You've sent a lot of messages recently — please wait a few minutes and try again.

capability.paidUpCredit: ✅ You're all paid up — you have a credit of {{credit}}.
capability.planNone: You don't have an active service on file. If that's unexpected, reply 4 to report it.
capability.invoicesNone: You have no invoices on file yet.
